description: The bar chart illustrates the number of sentences distributed across various text categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Categories", and lists the following items in an unsorted order with diagonally rotated text: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis represents the values, featuring a vertically oriented label "Sentences (K)" to indicate units in thousands. It utilizes a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 800 and tick marks at regular intervals of 200. The chart displays vertical bars primarily colored in light red. With one exception, each bar is annotated with its exact numerical value in dark blue text positioned directly above it. The tallest bar corresponds to "News" with an annotated value of 902, extending beyond the highest y-axis tick mark, while the shortest bar is for "Blogs" with a value of 2. Other annotated light red bars include "Administrative" at 525, "Non-fiction" at 190, "Science" at 110, "Fiction" at 35, and "Law" at 23. The bar for the "Religion" category is visually distinct; it consists of a light red base reaching approximately 50 on the y-axis, topped with a light grey rectangular block that extends to approximately 150, and it does not feature a numerical annotation.
